about: Shared test vectors for the composer reducer (docs/plans/2026-11-12-composer-tray.md). Each case deep-merges `given` onto `base` (objects merge, arrays and scalars replace), applies `intent`, and checks `expect` against the new state plus `derived` (a partial match: objects match the keys listed, arrays match length and each element partially) and `effects` (same length, each partial). Run by apps/web/test/composer.test.ts and FrogTests/ComposerReducerTests.swift. A behaviour change is a new case here; both fail until they agree.
